# fastclick-udpgen-quad

UDP Traffic loop Module, using 4 NICs

Supports 4 sending NICs, but is much more limited than [fastclick-play-single-mt](fastclick-play-single-mt.md)

This will generate UDP traffic using 4 NICs.
Packets are expected to come back, and the sum of UDP
traffic is accounted for and printed as the RESULT.

`GEN_WAIT` is the test time, while the client generates `GEN_FLOWS` flows of `GEN_BURST` packets in loop.

Source: [`modules/fastclick-udpgen-quad.npf`](https://github.com/tbarbette/npf/blob/main/modules/fastclick-udpgen-quad.npf)

## Variables

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `GEN_BURST` | `32` | Number of packets of each flow |
| `GEN_FLOWS` | `128` | Number of flows |
| `GEN_LENGTH` | `64` | Packet size in bytes |
| `GEN_WAIT` | `5` | Test time in seconds |

```{collapse} Late variables

Late variables are evaluated after the variables above.

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `GEN_TOT` | `EXPAND( $(( $GEN_BURST * $GEN_FLOWS )) )` |  |
```
